title: 第25章 五十年一遇的武道骄月第26章 药浴提升
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: “厉害啊！”
林菲赞叹地喊了一声，脸上带笑，有些惊喜。
别人看不出来，可他作为总教练再看不出来就有些不称职了。
林野在挥拳时的发力分明达到了堪称完美的程度，就算是让他来也不一定能做得更好。
单从身体素质而言，目前的林野和卫谦比起来其实还有差距。
但在这种发力状态下，林野却能稳定打出更强力的拳劲。
“拳法入门了？”
走到近前，他开口询问。
大厅里的几名新学员看到林菲过来，脑海中浮现出上周五梳理拳劲时的画面。
这一瞬间，甚至连当时的痛觉都跟着回忆起来。
匆忙逃窜似的躲到大厅角落，找上一个拳桩就开始挥拳，展现自己‘刻苦用功’。
林野不慌不忙的解开手上的拳带，“侥幸。”
林菲抬手按上林野的手背，制止了他解开拳带的动作。
“不用解，上二楼......嗯？”
正说着，林菲忽的面露几分疑惑，手掌一翻，轻轻捏住林野的手腕。
刹那间，林野只觉得浑身一麻，酥软软的，完全使不出任何力气。
不等他心头惊讶，林菲的声音传入耳中。
“上周五回去之后就拳法入门了？”
林菲看着林野有些诧异，手上不自觉地又用力捏了捏。
五天时间就拳法入门，不是算是，真的是上等资质啊？
他居然看走眼了？
稀奇诶！
林野听到林菲的问话心头一凛，他原本想说周六晚上入门的。
这样虽然超出了林菲的预测，但相差并不大。
不仅不会引起怀疑，还能提升一下他在林菲眼中的天才程度，免得以后拳法进境太快显得突兀。
可结果......搭下手就发现了？
而且，这股劲道是怎么回事？碰一下就让他失去了行动能力？
不过很快他就恢复镇定，笑着开口：“比教练差点。”
林菲咧嘴一笑，松开手挥了挥，“那能一样吗？”
“我从三岁身子骨还没定型的时候就要进行药浴，起点比你高太多了。”
说到这，他微微偏头思索。
“别说是你，就算是颜仪也没法和我比。”
“我用的药材都很珍贵，规格品质比她的起码强上三五倍不止。”
听到林菲的话，林野脸上的笑容有些僵住。
原来...是这样吗？
看到林野的表情，林菲忍不住咧嘴笑了起来。
他换了个站姿，更随意些。
“行了，别纠结这些了，我知道你怎么想的，不就是不想太高调嘛？”
“没必要，因为天赋更好的还有更多。”
“咱们馆主的亲传大弟子，也就是咱们大师姐。”
content_en:
"Awesome!"
Lin Fei shouted in admiration, with a smile on his face and some surprise.
Others can't see it, but if he can't see it as a head coach, he's a bit incompetent.
Lin Ye's power when punching was clearly perfect. Even if he was allowed to do it, he might not be able to do better.
In terms of physical fitness alone, there is actually a gap between Lin Ye and Wei Qian.
But in this state of exertion, Lin Ye was able to stably punch more powerfully.
"Have you started with boxing?"
Coming closer, he asked.
Several new students in the hall saw Lin Fei coming, and the scene when they were sorting out their boxing skills last Friday came to mind.
At this moment, even the pain felt at that time was recalled.
He hid in the corner of the hall as if escaping in a hurry, found a boxing post and started punching, showing that he was 'working hard'.
Lin Ye unhurriedly untied the fist belt on his hand, "It's a fluke."
Lin Fei raised his hand and pressed on the back of Lin Ye's hand, stopping him from untying his fist belt.
"No need to explain, go to the second floor... huh?"
Just as he was talking, Lin Fei suddenly looked a little confused, turned his palm over, and gently pinched Lin Ye's wrist.
In an instant, Lin Ye felt numb and limp all over his body, unable to exert any strength at all.
Before he could be surprised, Lin Fei's voice reached his ears.
"Have you started practicing boxing since you went back last Friday?"
Lin Fei looked at Lin Ye with some surprise, and squeezed her hand unconsciously.
Getting started with boxing in five days is not considered, is it really a first-class qualification?
He actually made a mistake?
Strange!
Lin Ye's heart trembled when he heard Lin Fei's question. He originally wanted to get started on Saturday night.
Although this exceeded Lin Fei's prediction, the difference was not big.
Not only will it not arouse suspicion, but it will also enhance his level of genius in Lin Fei's eyes, so that his subsequent boxing skills will not appear abrupt if he advances too quickly.
But in the end...I found out when I took a hand?
Moreover, what’s going on with this strength? One touch and incapacitated him?
But he quickly regained his composure and said with a smile: "Worse than the coach."
Lin Fei grinned, released his hand and waved, "Can it be the same?"
"I have been taking medicinal baths since I was three years old when my body was still in shape. My starting point is much higher than yours."
Having said this, he tilted his head slightly to think.
"Don't say it's you, even Yan Yi can't compare with me."
"The medicinal materials I use are all precious, and their specifications and quality are at least three to five times better than hers."
After hearing Lin Fei's words, the smile on Lin Ye's face froze.
So...is that so?
Seeing Lin Ye's expression, Lin Fei couldn't help but grin.
He changed his stance to be more casual.
"Okay, don't worry about this. I know what you think. Don't you just want to be too high-profile?"
"It's not necessary, because there are many more talented people."
"The eldest disciple of our master, who is also our senior sister."
title_en: Chapter 25: The Martial Arts Pride that only happens once in fifty years Chapter 26: Medicinal Bath Improvement
